operation_details.item: The user's Service 1 has a 99.9% availability SLA.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How is the service architecture review progressing?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I’m organizing the reliability requirements before making any implementation decisions.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A useful first step is to separate the requirements by service and make the availability expectations visible to the team.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That target can guide the resilience priorities for Service 1 and help distinguish them from lower-criticality work.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Keeping those service expectations explicit should make architecture trade-offs easier to review without assuming every component needs the same level of resilience.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: The differing targets provide a basis for prioritizing operational effort and evaluating whether proposed designs match each service’s requirement.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: SLA targets are tracked in the reliability dashboard.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That dashboard can serve as the shared reference during design reviews and ongoing reliability work.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I’ll use the dashboard targets when comparing the architecture options.
